theorem Formalism.VW.rh_of_right (hz : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → s ≠ 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  unfold RiemannHypothesis
  intro s hs htriv hs1
  rcases lt_trichotomy s.re (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs
      norm_num at hs
    have ht : 1 / 2 < (1 - s).re := by
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have h1 : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hs0
      linear_combination -h
    have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 - s) ≠ -(n : ℂ) := by
      intro n h
      have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hr
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      linarith
    have key := riemannZeta_one_sub hnat h1
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, hs] at key
    have hz' := hz (1 - s) ht h1
    have h2pi : (2 : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ^ (-(1 - s)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.2 (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hpi)))
    have hG : Complex.Gamma (1 - s) ≠ 0 := Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith)
    have hcos : Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (1 - s) / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Complex.cos_eq_zero_iff]
      rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      have h3 : ((1 - s) - (2 * (k : ℂ) + 1)) * (Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by
        linear_combination 2 * hk
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h | h
      · have hsk : s = -2 * (k : ℂ) := by linear_combination -h
        have hre : s.re = -2 * (k : ℝ) := by
          rw [hsk, Complex.mul_re]
          simp
        rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk0 | hk0 | hk0
        · have : (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ -1 by omega)
          linarith
        · apply hs0
          rw [hsk, hk0]
          simp
        · apply htriv
          refine ⟨(k - 1).toNat, ?_⟩
          have hnk : ((k - 1).toNat : ℤ) = k - 1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
          have h' : (((k - 1).toNat : ℕ) : ℂ) = (k : ℂ) - 1 := by
            have := congrArg (fun m : ℤ => (m : ℂ)) hnk
            push_cast at this
            exact this
          rw [hsk, h']
          ring
      · exact hpi h
    exact (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h2pi hG) hcos) hz') key.symm
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hs (hz s hgt hs1)

theorem UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.recTExists :
    UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.RecTExists := by
  intro E Ω _ _ _ _ _ A w h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.artEx E Ω A w h
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.cuspEx E Ω A w h a ha
  obtain ⟨⟨rc, hrc⟩, hcu⟩ :=
    GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.exists_isLExt UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.exh UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.multi E Ω A w h r
  have hcusp : ∀ x : IrrGL (HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion E w), x.IsCusp → rc x = r x :=
    hcu rc hrc
  have hD := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDim E Ω A w h a ha r rc hr hrc
  have hT := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extTw E Ω A w h a ha r rc hr hrc
  refine ⟨rc, a, ha, ?_⟩
  refine
    { dim := fun x => (hD x).1.1
      one := fun χ hχ => (hcusp _ (IrrGL.isCusp_ofChar χ hχ)).trans (hr.one χ hχ)
      langlands := ?_
      cusp := ?_
      nu := hT.1
      absCentral := fun x ω hω σ => ((hD x).2 ω hω σ).1
      twist := ?_
      central := fun x ω hg hω σ => ((hD x).2 ω hω σ).2 hg
      dual := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDual E Ω A w h a ha r rc hr hrc
      inj := UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extInj E Ω A w h a ha r rc hr hrc
      depth := fun x hg hx => UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDepth E Ω A w h a ha r rc hr hrc x hg hx
      type := ?_ }
  · intro l x hl
    rw [hrc l x hl]
    unfold GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.segSum
    congr 1
    refine List.map_congr_left ?_
    intro Δ _
    rw [hcusp _ Δ.isCusp_first]
  · intro x hx
    rw [hcusp x hx]
    exact hr.irr x hx
  · intro x χ hχ hg
    rw [hcusp _ (IrrGL.isCusp_ofChar χ hχ), hr.one χ hχ]
    exact hT.2 x χ hχ hg
  · refine (UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.typeIff E Ω A w h rc).2 ?_
    intro x
    unfold UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.TypeAt
    intro g _ i hi n hn D R hR θ hθ τ hτ hN σ hσ hinf
    have hx : x.IsCusp := by
      subst hσ
      exact IrrGL.isCusp_of.2 ⟨hn, DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzLc.isCuspidal_of_inflates i hi τ hτ σ hinf⟩
    rw [hcusp x hx]
    exact hr.type x hx g i hi n hn D R hR θ hθ τ hτ hN σ hσ hinf
